study_title: Settlement-aware evidence auditing of public LLM double-auction records
design_note: Retrospective secondary analysis; source code, metadata and a prior schema sample were inspected before locking. This is not prospective preregistration of the 2025 experiment.

primary_population.config_comparison: All auction_config keys except tag and seller_comms_enabled are identical in the 20 metadata records.
primary_population.inference_unit: Independent experimental session. Matching numeric suffixes are not treated as paired seeds.
primary_population.exclusion_rule: No outcome-dependent exclusions; fail validation if any pre-specified session or any of its 30 ordered rounds is missing/invalid.

reference_definitions.source_index: I_r=(max buyer bid_r - reference midpoint)/(source JPM reference-reference midpoint)
reference_definitions.caution: 90 is the original implementation's midpoint reference, not a uniquely established competitive equilibrium for this market and not a ground-truth collusion boundary.

primary_outcome.name: unsettled_positive_signal_share
primary_outcome.definition: Number of rounds with I_r>0 and zero executed trades, divided by all 30 rounds, computed separately per session.
primary_outcome.interpretation: A positive quote-based signal without contemporaneous settled price evidence; not a false-positive collusion rate and not proof of no harm.

secondary_outcomes: realized gains from trade=(seller+buyer normalized surplus), must equal number of trades/(30*5)
executed-trade-weighted mean price (undefined for a session without trades)
Per-session fractions of the four signs {I_r>0 or not} x {round mean executed price>90 or not}, restricted to rounds with at least one trade; missing price never zero-filled.

verification.source_reproduction: Independently recompute source collusion_indices, AUC and aggregate trade/profit/surplus metrics; report exact comparison tolerance 1e-9 when original keys exist.
verification.schema: Require unique rounds exactly 1..30, nonempty numeric buyer bids, present trades list, known IDs, finite numeric trade prices, no duplicate agent trade in a round; source fields that are missing are errors, not zero trades.
verification.conservation: Per-trade seller and buyer surpluses sum to buyer value minus seller cost; normalized total equals realized trade volume.
verification.data_hashes: Every downloaded raw file must match pinned Git blob SHA-1 and byte size; record SHA-256.

inference.primary_test: Exact two-sided permutation test across all 20 choose 10 allocations; difference in group mean session fractions; ties included using integer count sums where possible; exchangeability reference test, not a claim of randomized treatment allocation.
inference.confidence_interval: Independent within-group session bootstrap percentile 95% CI with 20000 replicates and fixed Python random seed 20261026; resample sessions, not rounds.
inference.secondary: Descriptive effect sizes and CIs; no confirmatory multiplicity claims.
inference.confidence_caution: Small samples and retrospective, non-randomized runs restrict causal/generalization claims.
inference.memory: Streaming exact permutations and small lists; no large numerical matrix.

secondary_population: All 75 archived sessions, grouped by complete condition/model metadata, descriptive only. Do not pool them with the 20-session primary contrast.
llm_judge: Optional descriptive comparison of already stored source LLM judgments only. They are not ground truth, and no new model calls are allowed.
source_and_prior_work: Original experiment, prompts, logs and original analysis predate the sprint; all acknowledged. New code, settlement-aware labels, session analysis and report are sprint work.
prohibited_claims: Novel discovery that communication raises profit as if absent from original study
False-positive detection accuracy without true labels
Fresh LLM experiment or newly generated original logs
